note: Condition summaries are concise paraphrases for in-app tooltips, not verbatim rulebook text. Verify against the rulebook before public release.
general: Conditions represent ways you can be hurt outside of Wounds.
A condition may end at the end of a scene (GM's discretion); some persist until treated.
The same condition can apply more than once and the penalties stack, e.g. Hindered (2) = +2 DN, Bleeding (3) = 3 Mortal Wounds per turn.
If you suffer several conditions with similar penalties, they don't stack — use only the worst.
Defence can be reduced to a minimum of 1; you can't voluntarily take an action that would drop it below 1.

conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.summary: Take 1 Mortal Wound at the end of each of your turns (per rank). Ends on a successful Toughness test (DN 4) or when an ally aids you with Medicae.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.summary: You can't see properly: +4 DN to all sight-based tasks, including every Combat test (replaces lesser vision penalties). May be removed with a Combat Action at the GM's discretion.

conditions.name: Exhausted
conditions.summary: You can only Walk/Crawl, make a basic attack, or Fall Back, and can't roll Determination. Any Shock you take converts straight into Mortal Wounds. Ends when you recover Shock (or per its source).

conditions.name: Fear
conditions.summary: Roll Resolve vs the source's DN. On a failure, +2 DN to all tests until the scene ends or an ally passes a Leadership (Wil) test. Fear-causing beings are immune to Fear and Intimidation.

conditions.name: Frenzied
conditions.summary: You must charge and attack the nearest visible enemy, always using All-Out Attack. Immune to Fear, can't be Pinned, and gain +1 Strength. May resist at the start of your turn with a DN 3 Willpower test.

conditions.name: Hindered
conditions.summary: +1 DN to all tests per rank (Hindered (2) = +2 DN). Lasts until the end of your next turn unless stated otherwise.

conditions.name: On Fire
conditions.summary: Take 1d3 Mortal Wounds at the start of each of your turns. Spend your Action to go Prone and put it out (DN 3 Athletics), or ignore it and risk becoming Hindered (DN 3 Willpower).

conditions.name: Pinned
conditions.summary: Caught by suppressing fire: you can't leave cover (moving to the nearest cover if exposed), though you may still take other actions, and take +2 DN firing back at whoever pinned you. Ends if an ally rallies you (Leadership test).

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.summary: +2 DN to all tests. Ends when treated with Medicae or when you pass a Toughness test (DN set by the poison) at the start of your turn.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.summary: Knocked down: Defence -2 against attackers within 5m, but +1 Defence against attacks from 6m or more. Standing up is a Free Action (Standard Movement only that turn).

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.summary: You can't use your Movement and your Defence is reduced by 2.

conditions.name: Staggered
conditions.summary: Your Speed is halved when you move and you can't Run or Sprint. Lasts until the end of your next turn.

conditions.name: Terror
conditions.summary: Roll Resolve vs the source's DN. On a failure you suffer all the effects of Fear and must flee using every action until you have no line of sight to the source. Fear bonuses/immunities also apply to Terror.

conditions.name: Vulnerable
conditions.summary: Defence -1 (certain effects increase this penalty). Lasts until the end of your next turn.
